_comment: Facts for autohaus-burger.de, every node cites its source_url. Unpublished values are left out, never invented.

nodes.name: Autohaus Burger GmbH & Co. KG
nodes.notes: Legal entity per Impressum: Registergericht Ulm HRA 1657; general partner Burger GmbH (HRB 4357); managing: Joachim Burger. Single site. Opening hours: the site publishes hours per department only (see department rows).

nodes.name: Autohaus Burger Blaubeuren
nodes.notes: Only showroom/site listed. Billing address Ehinger Str. 21-25; Impressum lists 17 + 21-25. Maps URL is a search link built from the address (site publishes no Maps link). Opening hours: the site publishes hours per department only (see department rows).

nodes.name: New car sales (Neuwagenverkauf)
nodes.notes: New cars currently online are Volkswagen only.

nodes.name: Service counter (Service)
nodes.notes: Online booking via myAudi, Volkswagen We, SEAT, CUPRA, SKODA and commercial-vehicle guest booking. Saturday: only the counter is staffed (footer note). 24-hour key safe (24 STUNDEN SCHLÜSSELTRESOR) on /service/ for dropping off or collecting keys outside opening hours.

nodes.name: Workshop (Werkstatt)
nodes.notes: Footer shows Service und Werkstatt 07:00-18:00 / Sa 08:00-12:00, but the footer's asterisk says the workshop is closed on Saturday; /kontakt/ values used.

nodes.name: Parts & accessories (Teile- und Zubehörverkauf)
nodes.notes: Express parts service, 98% of parts within 24h.

nodes.name: Vehicle purchase (Ankauf)
nodes.notes: Advice line +49 7344 96 00 40. Opening hours and brands: not published for this department.

nodes.name: Fleet & corporate customers (Großkunden)
nodes.notes: Large-account service centre for Audi and VW; sales contact line -99. Named staff omitted on purpose. Opening hours: not published for this department.

nodes.name: JobCar (employee car leasing)
nodes.notes: Opening hours and brands: not published for this department.

nodes.name: Body & paint shop (Karosserie- und Lackfachbetrieb)
nodes.notes: Accident repair, paintwork, dent removal, windscreen repair. No brand restriction or separate hours stated on the site. Opening hours and brands: not published for this department.

nodes.name: E-mobility (E-Mobilität by Burger)
nodes.notes: EV advice, charging solutions, installation service, tariffs, subsidies; advice line +49 7344 96 00 0. No brand restriction or hours stated. Opening hours and brands: not published for this department.

nodes.name: 24h emergency & towing (Notdienst)
nodes.notes: Accident, breakdown and towing hotline. Brands: not published for this department.
